overview: Big day for AI and markets: Anthropic filed its S-1 for an IPO, and OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra, pitched on computer use, alongside three AI-assisted science results. On the market side, Burry (via a tracker account) compares today's S&P breadth to 2000, and Tesla added Latvia as the 10th European country for supervised FSD. A lot of the feed was election and politics noise, which is skipped below.

top_items.title: saranormous - Anthropic filed its S-1; she flags rising operating profit and a staggered year-plus lockup instead of a 180-day cliff
Sam Altman - OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, pitched on faster, cheaper computer use across apps
Greg Brockman - OpenAI announces AI-aided discoveries in harmonic analysis, complexity theory and quantum field theory
burrytracker - Burry says 23% of S&P stocks are down 40%+ and only 15 hit new highs, likening it to just before 2000
Peter Steinberger - After weekend tests, he says Bun's AOT compiler gave 2-3x performance and under half the memory use
Elon Musk - Supervised FSD approved in Latvia, the 10th European country; Tesla robotaxi also widened its Houston area
Jensen Huang - At GTC Berlin he pitched Vera Rubin DSX POD factories, an Agent Toolkit, and RTX Spark agents for Windows PCs
Patrick Collison - Stripe's Link launches 'Link balance' so AI agents can spend a set budget on your behalf
